    11  /-!
    12  # Extensions of Lie algebras
    13  
    14  This file defines extensions of Lie algebras, given by short exact sequences of Lie algebra
    15  homomorphisms. They are implemented in two ways: `IsExtension` is a `Prop`-valued class taking two
    16  homomorphisms as parameters, and `Extension` is a structure that includes the middle Lie algebra.
    17  
    18  Because our sign convention for differentials is opposite that of Chevalley-Eilenberg, there is a
    19  change of signs in the "action" part of the Lie bracket.
    20  
    21  ## Main definitions
    22  * `LieAlgebra.IsExtension`: A `Prop`-valued class characterizing an extension of Lie algebras.
    23  * `LieAlgebra.Extension`: A bundled structure giving an extension of Lie algebras.
    24  * `LieAlgebra.IsExtension.extension`: A function that builds the bundled structure from the class.
    25  * `LieAlgebra.ofTwoCocycle`: The Lie algebra built from a direct product, but whose bracket product
    26    is sheared by a 2-cocycle.
    27  * `LieAlgebra.Extension.ofTwoCocycle`: The Lie algebra extension constructed from a 2-cocycle.
    28  * `LieAlgebra.Extension.ringModuleOf`: Given an extension whose kernel is abelian, we obtain a Lie
    29    action of the target on the kernel.
    30  * `LieAlgebra.Extension.twoCocycle`: The 2-cocycle attached to an extension with a linear section.
    31  * `LieAlgebra.Extension.oneCochainOfTwoSplitting`: A 1-cochain attached to a pair of linear sections
    32    of an extension.
    33  
    34  ## TODO
    35  * `IsCentral` - central extensions
    36  * `Equiv` - equivalence of extensions
    37  
    38  ## References
    39  * [Chevalley, Eilenberg, *Cohomology Theory of Lie Groups and Lie
    40    Algebras*](chevalley_eilenberg_1948)
    41  * [N. Bourbaki, *Lie Groups and Lie Algebras, Chapters 1--3*](bourbaki1975)
    42  
    43  -/
    44  
    45  @[expose] public section
    46  
    47  open Function
    48  
    49  namespace LieAlgebra
    50  
    51  variable {R N L M : Type*}
    52  
    53  section IsExtension
    54  
    55  variable [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [LieRing N] [LieAlgebra R N] [LieRing M]
    56    [LieAlgebra R M]
    57  
    58  /-- A sequence of two Lie algebra homomorphisms is an extension if it is short exact. -/
    59  class IsExtension (i : N →ₗ⁅R⁆ L) (p : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ M) : Prop where
    60    ker_eq_bot : i.ker = ⊥
    61    range_eq_top : p.range = ⊤
    62    exact : i.range = p.ker
    63  
    64  lemma _root_.LieHom.range_eq_ker_iff (i : N →ₗ⁅R⁆ L) (p : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ M) :
    65      i.range = p.ker ↔ Exact i p :=
    66    ⟨fun h x ↦ by simp [← LieHom.coe_range, h], fun h ↦ (p.ker.toLieSubalgebra.ext i.range h).symm⟩

    69  def IsExtension.kerEquivRange (i : N →ₗ⁅R⁆ L) (p : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ M) [IsExtension i p] :
